title: Remove ID-only CreaturePart construction from semantic bone helpers
description:
## Summary

Replace resolved-consumer construction of throwaway `CreaturePart` objects with ID-based semantic bone helper overloads.

## User Mandate

> "Review this external audit + follow up delta audit and synthesize to durable tasks"

STRICT. This task is created only as the durable owner for the confirmed audit mechanism. Preserve the supplied audit provenance and do not broaden into a resolver rewrite.

## Scope

- Add string/ID-based overloads for limb segment and joint bone-ID resolution where the implementation reads only `CreaturePart.Id`.
- Migrate the three current resolved morphology/binding call sites.
- Retain existing `CreaturePart` overloads only where they carry meaningful domain data or compatibility is required.
- Do not add a second semantic derivation path or change DNA semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria

- No resolved-consumer call site creates a `CreaturePart` only to provide an ID to a helper.
- ID-based overloads return the same bone IDs as the existing overloads for representative normal and mirrored parts.
- Existing semantic resolver and morphology binding tests remain green.

## Validation

Run focused runtime tests for `SemanticBoneResolver` and morphology binding, runtime and runtime-test builds, and `git diff --check`. Unity execution is required before status changes to Done.

## Findings

Confirmed from both supplied animation audits and current source. `SemanticBoneResolver` and `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge` contain three ID-only `CreaturePart` constructions. `TSK-0124` is Done for shared decision authority and is not the owner of this separate API cleanup.

## Blockers

None known.

## Next Step

Inspect the helper overloads and migrate the three call sites with parity tests.

comments.body: Round 3 sequential review (2026-09-07). Reviewed Assets/Scripts/README.md, the full TSK-0145 record, and the current uncommitted SemanticBoneResolver.cs / SemanticBoneResolverTests.cs diff. Implementation evidence: resolver adds ID-based overloads for ResolvePartRootBoneId, ResolveLimbSegmentBoneId, and ResolveLimbJointBoneId; existing CreaturePart overloads delegate to them, preserving public APIs. The parity test covers normal and mirrored parts and terminal resolution. Scoped multiline search `rg -n -U --glob '*.cs' 'new CreaturePart\s*\{\s*Id\s*=' Assets/Scripts/Runtime Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime` found no production-runtime matches; MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge uses `ResolveLimbSegmentBoneId(part.Id, ...)`. Validation: `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore` exit 0; `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore` exit 0; `dotnet test ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore --no-build --verbosity minimal` exit 0; `git diff --check` exit 0. Unity Test Framework focused SemanticBoneResolver/morphology-binding run was not available because Unity.exe was not found in standard install locations. Project/skill target Unity version is 6000.0.35f1; test mode would be PlayMode runtime. No edit was made because no concrete acceptance gap was found. Residual risk: Unity-only test discovery/execution and morphology binding behavior remain unverified; task stays InProgress pending Unity validation.
